programs.title: Training **programs**
programs.intro: Choose your path. Open Training for anyone who wants to begin, the directed programs for those who want to go deeper, and the strategic projects for those who want to act.
programs.openIntro: An independent track for the widest circle of the nation's youth: eight monthly lectures from October to May, each season carrying the name of a leading, symbolic figure from the history of the Palestinian cause.
programs.directedIntro: Directed training builds capability and competence: four programs, two theoretical and two applied, six sessions each from January to June. They run at the same time, and each participant joins one program only.
programs.step1: Apply to the Academy in three short steps.
programs.step2: After review and acceptance you choose your program, and the link to each session reaches you before it starts.
programs.step3: One session a month, live on Zoom, in Al-Quds time.
programs.projectsIntro: Alongside education and training, the Academy launches strategic projects that contribute directly to the effort of comprehensive liberation and turn knowledge into role and responsibility.

projects.title: Projects & **initiatives**
projects.intro: The Academy does not rely on conventional exams: every participant or team in a directed program graduates with a practical engagement project (a media campaign, a political study, or a field initiative) that serves the effort of comprehensive liberation, presented in September each year. The Jil Altufan incubator selects ten projects a year and provides mentoring, networking, and legal, administrative, and technical support, with six months of follow-up.

apply.title: **Apply** to the Academy
apply.intro: One application for the whole Academy: apply in three short steps, and we follow up by email. Once accepted, you choose your program.
apply.formIntro: Three steps: your basic details, then your affiliation and accounts, then your motivation. It takes about five minutes; fields marked with a star are required.

students.title: Student **window**
students.intro: Everything you need in one place: how sessions work, how to join, and your program's schedule and materials.
how: All sessions are live on Zoom; there are no recordings.
Open Training is eight monthly lectures from October to May; the directed programs are six monthly sessions from January to June.
Times are announced in Al-Quds time; the site shows your local time beside them.
You receive each session's link by email before it starts, and the join button appears on the site {minutes} minutes before.
students.joinTitle: How do I join on Zoom?
join: Install the Zoom app on your phone or computer in advance.
Open the session link from the email, or from the schedule when the join button appears.
Join with your real name as registered so the instructor recognises you.
Keep your microphone muted until you're invited to speak.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.draftNote: Draft pending the Academy's review and approval.

p: When you apply we collect: full name, gender, date of birth, email, phone number, nationality, country of residence, profession, any organisation you belong to, links to your social accounts (optional), how you heard about the Academy, your motivation, a short note about yourself, and your CV (optional).
When you contact us we collect: name, email, subject, and your message.
To review applications and contact applicants, to send registered participants the links and times of live sessions, and to reply to messages.
Only the Academy's team responsible for reviewing applications and running the programs; CVs are visible to no one else. We do not sell data or share it with third parties for marketing.
Data is stored with the hosting and email providers the Academy contracts.
For as long as it is needed to run the program you applied to; then it is deleted or anonymised unless the law requires otherwise.
You can ask to access, correct, or delete your data by writing to the address below.
The site uses a single cookie to remember your preferred language. We use no advertising trackers.
For any question about this policy: {email}

terms.title: Terms
terms.draftNote: Draft pending the Academy's review and approval.

p: This site is the digital home of Jil Altufan Academy. Its content is for reading and learning; please don't republish it without permission.
Submitting an application does not mean automatic acceptance unless the program is open-registration. The Academy reviews applications and contacts applicants.
Information given in an application must be accurate.
Zoom links are for registered participants and must not be shared. The Academy may change times or cancel sessions, notifying registrants.
Participants are expected to follow the code of conduct published in the student window.
